title: On the Trajectory Regularity of ODE-based Diffusion Sampling
tldr_zh: PF-ODE轨迹与内容无关呈线性-非线性-线性形、近落3维子空间；GITS动态规划时间表5-10 NFE大幅降FID
tldr_en: PF-ODE sampling trajectories share a content-independent linear-nonlinear-linear shape in a ~3-D subspace; GITS DP time schedule cuts FID at 5-10 NFE.
